language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the spoon and lifts it clear of the table in frames 30–36 (wrist_left, wrist_right, ceiling), then carries and lowers it into the blue box in frames 37–56 (ceiling, wrist_right). The fingers open in frames 57–60, leaving the spoon inside the box (wrist_right). Frames 70–80 (ceiling) confirm that the spoon remains in the box as the empty gripper withdraws. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
